title: Reproduction code and raw results for "When Does Pseudo-Label Self-Training Help Few-Shot Cross-Domain Bearing Fault Diagnosis?"
description: Reproduction code and raw per-repetition results for a controlled, reproducible empirical study on few-shot cross-domain bearing fault diagnosis. The study compares an unadapted baseline, CORAL, MMD, DANN and confidence-guided pseudo-label self-training (plus a loss-matched pseudo-label variant) on CWRU (cross-load 0 hp to 3 hp) and Paderborn / PU (cross-speed 1500 rpm to 900 rpm), under an explicit CPU-thread-pinned and fully seeded protocol. All tables in the manuscript can be recomputed from the shipped JSON files with compute_statistics.py. The raw third-party datasets are not redistributed; download links and helper scripts are provided in the repository.
